_comment: Layer A source registry: existing and operating data centers.
facility_manifest.py reads this to publish a freshness signal for every
facility snapshot the client-visible surfaces load. Acquisition configs
added by the facility pipelines attach to the same source_id values, so
a source gains a pipeline without changing how the surface names it.
vintage_status is deliberately explicit. 'undeclared' means nobody has
recorded when the upstream data was true, which is a real state of the
world here and the thing the freshness signal exists to expose. It is
never inferred from the repository commit date: a snapshot committed
today can be two years old upstream.

sources.label: OSTI IM3 Open Source Data Center Atlas
sources.publisher: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory, IM3 / MultiSector Dynamics, US DOE Office of Science
sources.url_provenance: Located by search 2026-08-26. Record contents were NOT fetched: the CI egress proxy blocks osti.gov, msdlive.org and the atlas site, so the DOI, version and license remain unconfirmed. Confirming them is a one-time manual task, the same shape as the PA DEP layer pin.
sources.derivation: Facility locations derived from OpenStreetMap, with facility area, county and state computed by the publisher.
sources.notes: Largest dataset in the repository and the only one that cannot answer when it was last true. Pass 3 replaces the overwrite with a diff into Layer A candidates.

sources.label: Epoch AI Frontier Data Centers
sources.url_provenance: Attribution recorded on the Notion Complete Centers page: 'Epoch Frontier Dataset (lacking proprietary data)'. URL not fetched; egress blocked in CI.
sources.derivation: Publisher-maintained register of frontier training sites with power and capital-cost estimates.
sources.geography: Global; the surfaces show the United States rows.
sources.notes: 29 rows, 27 of them United States. Capital-cost and power figures are publisher estimates, not filings.
